### 1. Request, simulator role, authorisation
Celeste Arceneaux wants to pay the renewal of "the federal flood policy on your condominium" now, by credit card, herself, and expects the representative to tell her the amount. The simulator is passive: it supplies phone 5045510417 (then ZIP 70124, SSN4 1482) on request, says "go ahead" whenever told something "has to be put through or corrected before the renewal amount can be settled", and runs the payment tool with the exact figures given. Target object: the in-force NFIP Dwelling Form – Residential Condominium Unit policy 1104582261 (`find_dwelling_policies` → `d53070c0-…`, term 2025-11-01 → 2026-11-01).

### 2. Act / wait / refuse at 2026-10-14
Act now. Visible grounds: status `in_force`; remittance before the term end ("A renewal remittance is the amount the insured remits, before the term end, for the coming term"); the tier carries no ICC coverage (occupancy schedule: Residential Condominium Unit, ICC "No"), so the remittance schedule applies rather than being "referred to the underwriting desk"; premium payor `INSURED`; payment method credit card is accepted ("check, ACH, credit card, escrow disbursement").

### 3. Objects and correlation keys
Policy `d53070c0-464b-42ec-babf-9a6d1871bbf1`. Servicing records on it: three renewal offers (latest `ba207704…`, recorded 2026-09-17, renewal_term_start 2026-11-01, indicated 2268.00); EC record `78b0887f…` (applied, re-rated risk 1021.37); three pending endorsements with no effective date, all with loan closing 2026-09-25 and the policy's own loan number 1408837265: `f431cc25…` COVERAGE_INCREASE recorded 09-21 (building 190000, contents 30000 = unchanged; engine RP 1460.00), `5b2e9d71…` COVERAGE_INCREASE recorded 09-22 (building 190000, contents 50000; RP 1484.00), `a96f04e2…` DEDUCTIBLE_DECREASE recorded 09-23 (deductibles 1250/1250; RP 1520.00). Billing, current term: RP 1316.00, RFA 236.88, HFIAA 250.00, FPF 47.00 (posted 2025-09-17); payments 1849.88 CREDIT_CARD 2025-10-20 and 24.41 CHECK 2026-09-24; RERATE credits RP 40.36 and RFA 7.26 posted 2026-10-01 referencing the EC. Claims: 1260921904 DOL 2026-09-21 paid 1650.00 on 2026-10-02 (expiring term); 1240911376 DOL 2024-09-11 (earlier term, excluded). HomeFlood (other product): HF1180336 HomeFlood Standard at 142 Mirabeau Ave, cancelled `PROPERTY_SOLD`, effective 2026-02-10. Prior-term billing rows excluded from the expiring-term reads.

### 4. Scored parameters (in words, with the tiers)
Prerequisite writes (item 6) are computed first; every one uses current-term days 365 (2025-11-01 → 2026-11-01).

(a) Building-limit increase `f431cc25` (billing schedule "Building-limit increases recorded for a loan transaction"): receipt date = later of request date 09-21 and latest payment on/after it (check 09-24) = 2026-09-24. Anchor tier "loan closing date and premium received no later than that date" (09-24 ≤ 09-25) → anchor 2026-09-25; waiting-days tier 1 → 0 days; premium window 30 days (check, 3 days) inside; quote window 60 days (closing recorded, paid by closing; 3 days) inside; transaction window 30 days (loan number = the policy's; closing 4 days after request) inside → effective 2026-09-25, 37 days to term end. Rise tier "re-rate credit from an applied EC booked on the current term after the request was recorded" (credit posted 10-01 > 09-21) → 1460.00 − 1316.00 = 144.00. Charge 144 × 37/365 = 14.60; RFA 18 % → 2.63; endorsed risk premium = rated 1021.37 + 144.00 = 1165.37.
(b) Contents-limit increase `5b2e9d71` (request now carries the policy's building limit 190000): receipt 09-24, same dating → 2026-09-25; rise tier "building-limit increase for the same loan closing has been billed" → 1484.00 − 1460.00 = 24.00; charge 2.43; RFA 0.44; endorsed 1189.37.
(c) Deductible decrease `a96f04e2`: receipt 09-24 → 2026-09-25; rise tier "limit increase recorded last for the same loan closing has been billed" (`5b2e9d71`) → 1520.00 − 1484.00 = 36.00; charge 3.65; RFA 0.66; endorsed 1225.37.
(d) Renewal remittance (pay_renewal_premium): rated as primary residence (condo tier "Yes" for the lower surcharge; `primary_residence: True`) → cap 18 %. Rise kept outside the cap tier "deductible decrease recorded last took effect during the expiring term" (effective 09-25) → 1520.00 − 1316.00 = 204.00. Capped = (1225.37 − 204.00) × 1.18 = 1205.22, + 204.00 = 1409.22; lower of indicated 2268.00 → renewed RP 1409.22. RFA 253.66; HFIAA primary 25.00; probation none; FPF rated 47.00 → renewal premium 1734.88. Adjustment (set-off, insured payor): premium account after (a)–(c) = −72.03 + 24.41 = −47.62 credit (≤ renewal premium) → 1687.26. Limits: bill window 45 days (mortgage-required; 27 days) inside; claim window 45 days (the expiring term's claim with latest DOL has a payment; 27 days) inside; term-end window 30 days (start premium paid in full by credit card; 18 days before term end) inside → no floor. Credit: residence credit tier "move after term start, more than half the term's days from move date to term end" (HomeFlood sale effective 2026-02-10, 264 of 365 days) → (250 − 25) × 264/365 = 162.74. Amount 1524.52, residence_credit 162.74, method CREDIT_CARD.

Fall-back (renewal computation document alone, product figures it names, prerequisites done): 1225.37 × 1.18 = 1445.94; RFA 260.27; 25.00; 47.00 → remittance 1778.21 — definite and different from 1524.52.
Factor findability (records words → document): "DEDUCTIBLE_DECREASE … change_effective_date in the expiring term" → "Coverage Changes of the Expiring Term and the Renewal Cap"; `premium_balance` −47.62 / billing credits → "Premium Account Balances Set Against a Renewal Remittance"; HomeFlood record "cancelled PROPERTY_SOLD" + policy `primary_residence: True` vs booked HFIAA 250 → "Residence Credit on the HFIAA Surcharge" (names HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies and the sale); renewal offer recorded date, `mortgage_required`, claim rows, payment method rows → the bill/claim/term-end window documents. Endorsement factors: `loan_closing_date`, `loan_number`, payment `posted_date`/`payment_method`, RERATE credit rows → the anchor/waiting/window/rise documents of each schedule. None was reachable only through a computation document's wording.

### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials alone
Root: renewal remittance. Edges (blocked ← depends on):
1. Remittance ← all three coverage changes billed. Sentence in the remittance hub: "The renewal remittance is fixed only after the premium account for the expiring term carries the charge for every coverage change recorded during that term." Records: three endorsement rows recorded in the term with no effective date and no endorsement charge on the billing. Searching "endorsement charges … premium account for the current term" / "recorded for a loan transaction" (the rows carry `loan_closing_date`) finds the three billing schedules, each saying "Two endorsement charges are posted to the policy's premium account for the current term". **state-derived**.
2. Contents billing ← building billing. Contents hub: "The contents-increase charge is fixed only after the policy shows the building limit that the same loan transaction raised." Records: policy building 140000, `f431cc25` raises it to 190000 under closing 09-25; the building schedule says "the policy takes the limits and deductibles recorded on the request". Also the contents charge document bills only the request "that carries the building limit now on the policy". **state-derived**.
3. Deductible billing ← building and contents billing. Deductible hub: "The deductible-decrease charge is fixed only after the premium account carries the charge for every limit increase of the same loan transaction." Records: two COVERAGE_INCREASE rows with closing 09-25; the two limit schedules post the charges. **state-derived**.
Order: building → contents → deductible → customer's payment. No hop was handed over by a tool name, route or chain; no document names another problem's tool.
Counter-proof "do only the payment": paying 1778.21/any amount with the three endorsements unbilled leaves the expiring term's premium account without the charges for coverage changes recorded in it, which the remittance hub's sentence forbids; the remittance is not yet fixed. Closest alternatives excluded: indicated premium 2268 (cap rule takes the lower); cap 25 % (rated as primary residence); full gap 225 credit (move after the term start, so the proportional tier); set-off of −72.03 (the balance after the three charges is −47.62); rise basis against rated 1021.37 (the EC credit was posted after each request, so the term-start figure or the prior billed increase governs).

Policy-side notes (blind): none required to reach the answer.
